information_path: A probe physically visits a labeled marker and spends one ticket and stated fee. It then physically tastes a balanced four-pair pack. Harvest spends its ticket, receives one actual new B anchor receipt, then chooses a real B target with net +1 or -1 but no local B-choice receipt. A taste outcomes are information only, not utility.
evaluation: Actual per-life net utility and first no-receipt B choice, counting both missed and abstained as misses. Compare two separately trained gates to public Bayes structure baseline, explicit heuristic, fixed 1/2 per arena, no exploration, learned-confidence masked, and three independent timing permutations preserving each world and each arena probe budget and total fee. Held state counterfactuals vary displayed horizon/cost while original body stays identical.
readiness: Reward-trained active choice supported if paired net versus count-matched random and no-probe has a 95% lower above zero, plus a physically realized timing response to at least one changed public offer at same state. Compare to heuristic and public upper reference quantitatively without assuming an advantage.
